newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares seen soft, eye on Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares seen soft, eye on Wall St.

text.p: Chilean shares are expected to open slightly lower with the market undermined by Wall Street recent volatility, said traders.
Investors are also concerned that serious flooding in central Chile this week will drive up vegetable prices, fuelling inflation, they said.
"I think we'll start seeing rises in inflation forecasts in the next week," said one dealer.
Traders said the bolsa is likely to remain in the doldrums for the next few weeks as players wait for company first half results to filter into the market in mid-July.
The 40-share index closed Wednesday down 0.63 percent at 131.63 points.
